points.point: EVM stands for Error Vector Magnitude and is defined as a measurement of the difference between the reference waveform and the measured waveform (3GPP TS 38.521-1 test case 6.4.2.1).
points.label: partial
points.why: states EVM expansion and general comparison, but not the KB/3GPP reference definition

points.point: The EVM pass/fail limit depends on the chosen modulation scheme plus a Test Tolerance, so modulation/Test-ID selection directly changes the applicable limit (Pi/2-BPSK 30+TT%, QPSK 17.5+TT%, 16QAM 12.5+TT%, 64QAM 8+TT%, 256QAM 3.5+TT%).
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions standards/modulations affect EVM limits, but not Test ID, TT, or specific limits

points.point: EVM must be measured at both DUT max power and min power; CMX sets max power automatically first, then the DUT is driven to min power with TPC closed-loop settings (and 256QAM Test IDs target Pmin + 10 dB).
points.label: missing
points.why: no max/min power sequence, TPC closed loop, or Pmin+10 dB

points.point: An EVM measurement is only valid if the zero-forcing equalizer correction applied in the EVM measurement process meets the spectral flatness requirement (test cases 6.4.2.4 / 6.4.2.5).
points.label: missing
points.why: no zero-forcing equalizer or spectral flatness validity condition

points.point: Instrument option selection depends on EVM specs stated only under fixed conditions — e.g. the CMX500 R&S CMX-KM600 NR analyzer is EVM < 0.5 % only for FR1, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM, +15 °C to +35 °C and a defined input level/bandwidth.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions analyzer/generator EVM performance generally, not CMX500 KM600 fixed-condition spec

points.point: FR2 level-setting decisions are expressed as level ranges for best EVM on the R&S CMX-RF42E active RF frontend (TX/downlink and RX/uplink, per amplification setting).
points.label: missing
points.why: no CMX-RF42E best-EVM level ranges or amplification settings

points.point: EVM with an external local oscillator on CMXHEAD50/HEAD50-Evo requires an R&S SMA100B with an ultra-low-phase-noise option, and the Vault flags an unresolved option-code discrepancy (SMA-B711 vs SMAB-B711) to verify before configuring or quoting.
points.label: missing
points.why: no CMXHEAD50 external LO, SMA100B ULPN option, or option-code discrepancy

points.point: EVM is also a scoping item in product test plans and OTA/production setups: FWA CPE RF-parametric plans list EVM alongside output power, OBW and sensitivity BLER, and ATS1800C is described as supporting ACLR/EVM/EiRP/TRP/EiS measurements.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions OTA and production scoping generally, not FWA CPE or ATS1800C specifics
